{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABV0i5xg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzg_XIqE", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 71, "title": "Support selectable Japanese-English translation direction in Chrome extension", "body": "## Problem

The Chrome extension now provides optional local OPUS-MT Japanese → English translation for both provisional and final ReazonSpeech transcripts (#69), but the language direction is fixed. Users also need **English → Japanese** translation. Speech recognition already uses the ReazonSpeech ja-en bilingual model.

A translation model's supported direction must not be assumed reversible: the current `onnx-community/opus-mt-ja-en` checkpoint only handles Japanese → English.

## Expected outcome

Allow users of the Chrome extension to explicitly select either **Japanese → English** or **English → Japanese** translation while retaining the optional translation enable/disable checkbox. Both directions locally translate provisional and final transcripts and show original + translated text as in #69.

The direction control should be a two-option radio group or select, **not two independent checkboxes**, because exactly one direction is active. Keep Japanese → English as the default. Apply direction changes to the **next session**, as the live Pipeline graph is immutable; show this behavior clearly. No automatic language detection or multilingual expansion is required.

## Scope

- Add a separate production **EnglishToJapaneseOpusMtTranslationNode** (or an equally explicit direction-specific name) using a verified browser-compatible `en-ja` OPUS-MT checkpoint. Preserve the existing `ja-en` node. The model implementation belongs to its own Node, not a switchable model inside one Node or a generic selector/manager.
- Verify and pin the actual `en-ja` ONNX model ID, immutable revision, runtime compatibility, size/hash list, license and distribution terms before implementation. Do not invent a symmetric model ID or imply compatibility without checking.
- Reuse the existing Node/Port contract, worker inference, scheduler, final FIFO / provisional latest-wins coalescing, cancellation and paired original/translated display. Preserve both translation directions' accurate status and stale-output protection.
- Extend the #67/#69 extension-origin cache integration to the `en-ja` checkpoint with its own manifest and immutable cache keys. Model selection uses the corresponding verified asset set; downloading must be explicit, with progress, retry and offline cache reuse. Never bundle model weights into the extension or implicitly download the unselected model.
- Keep translation enable/disable independent of direction. The direction chosen before a session determines the fixed production Node/Pipeline graph for that session. Clearly label input/output languages in the UI, including provisional/final displays; do not relabel stale results from a previous session.
- Add the new independent English → Japanese Node Playground page and index entry for manual node evaluation, using the actual production node; keep the existing Japanese → English Playground intact. Avoid a generic model comparison page.
- Preserve current tab-capture, ReazonSpeech ASR, original transcript copying, all existing Japanese → English behavior and Chrome extension permissions/CSP wherever possible.
- Document model preparation, size, local-only inference, language-direction constraints and testing; no TranslateGemma integration in this issue.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- The extension UI offers the existing translation-enabled checkbox plus an exclusive Japanese → English / English → Japanese direction choice, defaulting to Japanese → English; selection is applied on the next session.
- Both directions translate **provisional and final** outputs with the original source visible. Provisional translations do not overwrite later text or finalized rows, and each final result remains ordered and paired.
- The English → Japanese direction uses a real verified and pinned browser-compatible `en-ja` model in its **own Node/Worker**. The existing `ja-en` node remains unchanged or only minimally refactored.
- Independent cache assets and readiness/progress/error states function for each model, including cache reuse after window recreation/profile restart where testable, eviction and offline behavior. No unexpected downloads, no inference server requests and no extra generic model framework.
- A standalone English → Japanese Playground test page invokes the production Node and is linked from the Playground index.
- Unit/browser/MV3 extension tests cover direction selection and preference lifecycle, correct Node selection, worker/cached asset loading, both-direction partial/final scheduling, failures, cancellation, repeat sessions and no regressions.
- An opt-in real-model browser/extension smoke proves English → Japanese output in an appropriate environment; report real inference distinctly from mocks, and record blockers/skips honestly. Tests of existing Japanese → English remain passing.
- Translation remains optional; the transcription-only mode is still available and works without either translation model.

## Required post-merge verification

For the newly published Node Playground page, verify after merge that GitHub Pages deployed the merged SHA, that the new page loads from the canonical repository-prefixed URL, and that its script/worker/model URLs are valid. Record run URL, SHA, time and results. Mark **pending** until completed; do not close this Issue before recording verification. The unpacked extension has no deployment-only verification gate.

## Context

- #7 — local-first composable Node/Port Pipeline vision.
- #65 — separate local OPUS-MT and TranslateGemma translation Nodes / Playground.
- #67 — extension-origin model cache foundation.
- #69 / PR #70 — current Japanese → English provisional/final OPUS-MT translation.
- `web/translation-models.js`, `web/translation-nodes.js`, `extension/session.js`, `extension/translation-scheduler.js`, `docs/translation-nodes.md`, `docs/chrome-extension.md`.

Keep scope to **Japanese and English only**, with user-selected direction (no automatic detection), and reuse existing production components rather than broadening the architecture.", "url": "https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/71", "created_at": "2026-10-08T09:31:47Z", "state": "OPEN", "repository": "takahirox/my-audio-to-text", "labels": ["task"], "priority": null, "status": "In Progress", "is_archived": false}, "context": {}, "resources": {}, "allocation": {}, "instruction": null, "run_id": "8d50306918fd45059efd6ceee40b4b94"}
